capabilities: generate video clips from text prompts into the current note
animate a vault image into a clip with it as the first frame
insert embeds at the cursor and save clips to a configurable vault folder
configure model, clip length and resolution
extras: The first clip is free; further runs cost credits at movoa.ai/pricing and each clip takes a few minutes. MIT licensed. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot create video content on its own, so users must generate clips on external sites and import them manually.

relations.evidence: This is the official Movoa plugin for Obsidian

summary: Generates AI video clips with sound from text prompts or vault images via the Movoa API, saving and embedding them in notes.
